oneOf.description:
PVPC 2.0TD: the energy term of the regulated household tariff. It carries the
cost of energy and the energy share of tolls and charges; taxes come on top. Hourly.
Day-ahead wholesale market price for the Spanish zone. Quarter-hourly.

PriceWindow.description: A candidate run window `[start, end)` and what energy costs on average inside it.

end.description: RFC 3339 timestamp carrying the Europe/Madrid UTC offset

mean_eur_per_mwh.description: Time-weighted mean price over the window.

start.description: RFC 3339 timestamp carrying the Europe/Madrid UTC offset

starts_in_minutes.description: Minutes from now until this window begins (0 = start immediately).

SearchSpan.description: The time span that was searched.

until.description: Latest allowed finish: the deadline, or the end of published prices if sooner.

Source.description: Where a document's data came from. Every document lists its sources.

cached.description: True when served from the local cache instead of the network.

fetched_at.description: When this program retrieved it from upstream.

name.description: Publisher of the data. Cite it when you reuse a figure.

updated_at.description: When the publisher last updated this data. Cite it along with the name.

url.description: The upstream request that produced it.

Tomorrow.description: What part tomorrow's prices played in a search.

oneOf.description: Published and part of the search.

The search reached into tomorrow but its prices are not out yet. Asking again
after publication may find a cheaper window.
The search reached into tomorrow but its prices could not be checked (see `warnings`).
The search ended today, so tomorrow did not matter.

description: The cheapest time to run something for a fixed duration.

alternatives.description: Further windows, each the cheapest that overlaps none of the ones before it.

earliest.description:
For comparison: the window that starts at the earliest allowed moment,
`searched.from`, which is now unless a later start was asked for. Null when
published prices do not cover a full run from that moment.

saving_eur_per_kwh.description: `earliest` mean minus `best` mean, in euros per kWh. Null without `earliest`.

saving_percent.description:
The same saving as a percentage of the `earliest` mean. Null when either mean
is zero or negative, where a percentage is meaningless.

warnings.description: Things that limited the answer, in plain words. Empty when nothing did.

title: Cheapest
